observations: Three photos show a large blue plastic drum with a red lid, placed outdoors on a concrete surface.
The drum has a white label with text and a barcode, but the text is not legible.
The drum has a black 'SA' marking on the side, possibly a seller's or inventory tag.
The drum appears to be used, with visible dirt, scuffs, and some water stains on the surface.
The lid is red and appears to be made of plastic, with a metal ring around the edge.
In the background, other drums (blue and white) are visible, suggesting a storage or sales yard.
The watermark 'AJAOS BUILDING MATERIALS' is present on all photos, indicating the seller's business name.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not visible on the drum in any photo. The label is unreadable, and no markings indicate the volume.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drum may not be food-grade or may have been used for non-food purposes.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label or any certification mark indicating food-grade material.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-food-grade or used for non-food purposes

risks.risk: The drum may have cracks, leaks, or structural damage not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the drum's body and lid, showing all edges and seams, especially around the metal ring and lid seal.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially leaking or damaged

risks.risk: The drum may have been previously used for hazardous materials, posing a contamination risk.
risks.proof: A photo of the label or any warning or hazard markings on the drum.

proof_requests: Close-up of the label on the drum showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the label on the drum to read the capacity and any certifications.
Close-up photo of the drum's body and lid, especially around the metal ring and seal.
Photo of any warning or hazard markings on the drum.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
